description: This file defines the TracesParserTransitions class, a specialized parser for handling transition traces in a tracing system, including filtering, decoding, and timestamp extraction.

classes.name: TracesParserTransitions
classes.description: A parser class for handling transition traces, combining WM and shell transition traces, providing decoded entries, descriptors, and timestamp extraction.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the parser with an array of parsers, filters for WM and shell transition traces, and sets descriptors.

methods.name: canProvideEntries
methods.description: Checks if both WM and shell transition traces are available for providing entries.

methods.name: getLengthEntries
methods.description: Returns the number of decoded transition entries.

methods.name: getEntry
methods.description: Retrieves a specific transition entry by index and timestamp type.

methods.name: getDecodedEntries
methods.description: Decodes and combines WM and shell transition entries into a unified list of transitions.

methods.name: getDescriptors
methods.description: Returns the combined descriptors from WM and shell transition traces.

methods.name: getTraceType
methods.description: Returns the trace type, which is TRANSITION.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Extracts a timestamp from a transition based on the specified timestamp type (ELAPSED or REAL).
